none: PAS YORYM-F86DD2: Roman Coin : Siliqua of Arcadius
contea di ritrovamento: Wiltshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [DN] ARCADIVS PF AVG ; R/ VOT//V//MVLT//X

TREASURE CASE : 2012 T612. Description: Coin 2. A silver siliqua of Arcadius dating to the period AD 383 - 388 (Reece Period 20). VOT//V//MVLT//X reverse type depicting wreath. Mint of Mediolanum (Milan). RIC IX, p.79, no.13. This coin has been broken roughly in half. Obverse Description: Diademed and draped bust right. Obverse Inscription: [DN] ARCADIVS PF AVG. Reverse Description: Wreath. Reverse Inscription: VOT//V//MVLT//X. Mint Mark: MDPS. Die Axis: 12. Dimensions: Diameter: 13.9mm; Weight 0.8g
